title: NOMIARC Tm 1 tomato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: NOMIARC Tm 1 tomato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: NOMIARC Tm 1 tomato is a tomato variety. About 61 days to harvest, 18.9 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: NOMIARC Tm 1 is a registered tomato variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2007 as NSIC 2007 Tm 13. DA NOMIARC bred it. It takes about 61 days from transplanting to the first harvest, with 18.91 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

NOMIARC Tm 1 tomato takes about 61 days from transplanting to the first harvest. That is 9.4 days faster than the average of the 20 tomato varieties with a day count, 70.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 18.91 t/ha trails the average of its group, 20.91. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

rows: Took some damage but held up
Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Fusarium wilt](/diseases/fusarium-wilt), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt).

The pests and diseases that hit tomato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [late blight](/diseases/late-blight), [tomato leaf curl](/diseases/tomato-leaf-curl), [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant NOMIARC Tm 1 tomato

It is recommended for both the wet and the dry season. It suits mid elevation areas. Bacterial wilt kills more lowland tomato than any other disease, so in the wet season pick a variety rated resistant to it. Choose a firm, oblong fruit if you sell to a far market, and a round, juicy one for fresh sale nearby. Heat tolerant hybrids set fruit in the hot months, when open pollinated tomatoes often drop their flowers. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 61 days from transplanting to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 18.91 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of NOMIARC Tm 1?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
